Name: Nyapu's Portraits Darker Hair for Sebastian
Author: Oceannist
Description:
Hello! （ﾉ´∀`）
I made a small edit to darken Sebastian's hair in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits inspired by Dong[/url] to better match his sprite, for my personal use.
Since some people were asking to share the images, I have decided to upload this here with Nyapu's permission.

[b]This is NOT a CP file![/b] They are just images!
I don't know how to make content patcher files, sorry! (シ_ _)シ

[b]How to Install[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download Nyapu's portraits mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]here[/url]﻿.
[*]Download this file and unzip it.
[*]Replace the Sebastian portrait images in the "assets" folder of Nyapu's mod with the images provided here.
[*]Place Nyapu's mod folder in your Stardew Valley mods directory.
[/list]
Remember to keep a copy of Nyapu's original portrait images in case you want to switch back!

Thanks to Nyapu for making this amazing mod and for the permission to upload this.
Sorry for my English! （ﾉ´д｀）
